acceptanceCriteria: A1: Preserve every WI-702 archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, Events, verification evidence, and canonical pre-merge finalization receipt byte-for-byte; record their repository-bound digests in successor evidence.

A2: Record the WI-702 successor recovery decision and explicitly document that PR #700's intervening parity-registry modification prevents a valid append-only finalization transition; do not reclassify the rejected transition as valid or rewrite WI-702 history.

A3: Independently verify PR #700's reviewed head 4eedf23ddf1e4a0491fb978127d61d852e6a5a1f, merge commit bd00a7ce888c2d0dba012da21ba1616eeeab0014, required hosted checks, synchronized origin/main, and exact WI-702 branch/worktree cleanup.

A4: Register the recovered WI-702/WI-712 parity truth in English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese reference projections, preserving the distinction between the recovered predecessor and this successor's closure boundary.

A5: Complete WI-712's Runtime lifecycle and successor finalization/close evidence with repository identity, Runtime identity, recovery binding, verification evidence, and a structured human decision; never claim a performance benefit from this governance recovery.
A6: Run the declared governance, documentation, and repository checks; after close, promote closed Work Item projections and leave the synchronized default branch ready only if Runtime confirms it.
goal: Reconcile WI-702's post-merge finalization boundary through an auditable successor, preserve its immutable truth, and complete the exact governance/parity closure without claiming an unproven performance benefit.
intent: WI-702 PR #700 is merged, but its immutable pre-merge finalization root cannot advance because the intervening reviewed range contains a modification to the pending parity registry in addition to the canonical receipt append. Use the Runtime's append-only successor recovery path, retain all predecessor bytes, and bind fresh post-merge evidence to the successor.

All production code benchmark behavior governance Runtime implementation and performance claims unrelated to the post-merge recovery boundary.
Other agents' Work Items branches worktrees PRs evidence or pending parity records outside the WI-702 row being reconciled.
